description: Story 21.9 — « Accès IA externe » (module mcp-access): the owner creates personal access tokens that let an external AI client (Claude, ChatGPT, an accountant's assistant) read the company's data through the Keevo MCP server. Owner only (other roles: 403 FORBIDDEN). Module mcp-access (plans TEAM, BUSINESS, BUSINESS_TRIAL, PREMIUM, PREMIUM_TRIAL; owner-disabled for companies that existed before it: « Mes modules ») gates GET /tools and POST /tokens; GET /tokens and DELETE /tokens/{id} stay open to the owner whatever the plan (an access can always be seen and revoked). Responses use Keevo's envelope: success {data, …}; error {error: French message to show, code: HTTP name, domainCode, details?}. The clear token is returned once, by the creation: the app shows it with a copy button and never stores it. Tool 'name' values are API handles: show 'label' only. Change this file only with both sides.

endpoints.notes: The tools the owner may put in an access now (their plan's modules); offer them as checkboxes.

Newest first, at most 10. 'hint' = last 4 characters of the token (show as « …x9Qa »). Expired accesses stay listed 30 days (« Expiré »), then disappear. 'available': false = the owner's plan or modules no longer allow this data: it stays in the access but the AI client neither sees nor reads it (show « Indisponible avec votre offre »). Accesses cut by « Déconnecter tous les appareils » or a suspension are removed from the list.

data.accessToken: same shape as a GET /tokens item

errors.error: La durée de validité doit être de 7, 30, 90 ou 365 jours | Une des données choisies n'est pas disponible pour votre compte | Choisissez entre 1 et 16 données accessibles | Le nom de l'accès est obligatoire (60 caractères au plus)
Vous avez atteint le nombre maximum d'accès IA externes : révoquez-en un avant d'en créer un autre.

endpoints.notes: Revoked at once: the AI client's next request is refused.

mcpServer.transport: MCP Streamable HTTP, stateless (protocol 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18, 2025-11-25). Only POST serves MCP; a GET with a valid access answers 405 (no SSE stream); any method without a valid access answers 401.
methods: tools/list (the access's tools still allowed to the owner)
tools/call (one AI credit per successful call)

httpRefusals.error: Accès refusé : ce jeton Keevo est invalide, expiré ou révoqué. Créez-en un nouveau dans l'application.
httpRefusals.notes: also when the owner is no longer the owner or after « Déconnecter tous les appareils » (access created before)
owner membership off or company deleted
the module's read-only grace after an expired subscription still serves (reads only)
21.4.2: a suspended company, or one whose deletion is pending, is refused (as every write of the JWT path)

30 requests per minute per access, 60 per company (a refused request counts nothing); an address whose authentications failed 20 times this minute gets 429 on its next failures only — a valid access is never refused because of its address (21.4.2)

mcpServer.toolErrors: A refused call is a tools/call result with isError=true and a French text (out of the access's scope, quota of AI credits used up, module or role refusal of the tool).

jsonRpcErrors.message: Méthode non prise en charge par le serveur Keevo
Une erreur est survenue. Réessayez dans un instant.

mcpServer.httpRefusalShape: 21.4.2: Keevo's error envelope {code: HTTP status name, domainCode, error: French message}
